name: duel_bottle_waits_for_its_horn
description: A bottle fizzles at fizzle_t after its own wave's horn, never the wave's before: both seats stand six arrows by the road's descent along x = 15 and call wave 1 at once, so it clears and window 2 opens 15 to 25 s after the first horn. Seat 1 corks there and nobody presses Ready, so the window runs past tick 1500, wave 1's horn plus fizzle_t: the bottle stays corked through it, and after window 2's own horn and uncork_after_t its reveal is taken (a bottle once fizzled there, before its wave began).

steps.assert: open > 900 and open < 1500 and m.drift_window == 2 and scene.refusals(1) == [] and scene.refusals(2) == []
steps.msg: wave 1 cleared and window 2 opened between 900 and 1500 ticks after the first horn, so tick 1500 falls inside it

steps.assert: scene.rows('FIZZLE', ['seat']) == [] and not m.bottles(1)[0]['fizzled'] and m.hollows[0].phase == 0
steps.msg: through tick 1500, still in the window, the bottle is corked
and is uncorked in its own wave
